content.comment_body: Hello, I'm encountering an issue where I cannot upload a website deployed using [product_name]. Although the shadow appears fine and the data upgrade works, uploading the website consistently triggers a warning. Has anyone faced something similar or knows a workaround? Thank you, [user_name]

Which version of [product_name] are you using? I ran into problems with the latest release of [product_name] ([version_no]), as it failed to deploy the web app to AWS and always resulted in a server error 500. I found that reverting to an older version ([version_no]) was the only way to successfully deploy to AWS. Based on recent experience, [version_no] seems to work best for most users with AWS, so you might want to use that version.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report difficulties uploading and deploying websites created with [product_name], especially when using newer software versions. Common issues include upload warnings and server errors. Many find older versions of the software to be more reliable when working with cloud services like AWS.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a straightforward and error-free process when uploading and deploying websites with [product_name], regardless of the software version, and seek dependable compatibility with hosting solutions such as AWS.
